entities.text: KAIROUAN KUFIC  -  unified system (book: قواعد الخط الكوفي القيرواني, pp. 3-6, 51)
1 nuqta (dot) = grid unit = 196 font units  (UPM 2048).  The dot is a square whose side is the pen width.
Pen width  W = 5/7 nuqta = 140 u      Vertical stroke  V = 5/7 W = 100 u      Horizontal stroke  H = 6/7 W = 120 u
Gap / hairline  G = 1/7 W = 20 u  (slots, cup arm, tah stem)      Stroke-end cut = pen edge at 60 deg: 70 u across, H up
Alif = 5 nuqta.   Line spacing = 6.5 nuqta.   Body letters (sad / tah / kaf) = 2H + G = 260 u.   Joins: band height H on the baseline.
Cells: 13 x 11 nuqta, baseline marked, dashed orange = H, dashed cyan = alif height.  Draw/keep glyphs on layer GLYPHS.
ba / ta / tha  ب ت ث
jeem / hah / khah  ج ح خ
